approved_scope.underlying_membership: all currently eligible NSE single-stock F&O underlyings
approved_scope.contract_coverage: every currently listed strike and expiry

approved_boundaries.purpose: private local data collection and data-quality research only

timestamp_treatment.limitation: Do not treat provider or last-trade time as proof of the time of the most recent best-bid or best-ask change.

approved_cadence.coverage: one complete batched quote snapshot of the approved universe per interval
approved_cadence.execution_claim: This is snapshot research data and must not be represented as tick-level or executable-price evidence.

approved_retention.deletion: delete expired records automatically according to their respective retention period

evidence: Aditya Lakhotia approved all currently eligible NSE single-stock F&O underlyings, every currently listed CE/PE strike and expiry, a 60-second complete-snapshot cadence, collection from 09:15 through 15:30 Asia/Kolkata on NSE trading days, 30-day raw retention, and three-year normalized/quality retention in the controlling conversation on 2026-09-19.
does_not_prove: The approved scope does not prove data completeness, quote freshness, executable prices, liquidity, slippage, costs, paper P&L, or a trading edge.
